## Summary
Software engineer with 3 years shipping production systems end to end in Go, TypeScript and Python, from data model and API design through deployment and monitoring. Built 0 to 1 at three early-stage startups: an AI learning platform on a Go backend reaching 10,000+ students, agent orchestration processing 15,000+ submissions, and real-time voice AI at 1.5-second latency for 500 daily users. Now consulting for HRtech, Edtech and services clients, with a multi-tenant SaaS ERP and a restaurant POS in production and 18 merged upstream pull requests in Go, Python and TypeScript. Author of fya, an open-source security scanner with 800+ downloads and 42 GitHub stars.

## Experience
- **Founding Engineer and Software Consultant, oorik Technologies** (Jun 2026 - Present, Delhi, remote clients). Consults for HRtech and Edtech clients on LLM features and backend services. Built oorik ERP (erp.oorik.in), a multi-tenant SaaS ERP for Indian SMBs: Hono API on PostgreSQL with Drizzle, 22 incremental migrations including row-level tenant isolation, Better Auth organisations, Razorpay subscription billing, 200+ vitest files gating CI, deployed on Railway and Vercel. Delivered a restaurant POS, kitchen display and online ordering stack for a Noida quick-service restaurant as a fixed-scope contract (Turborepo monorepo of 13 packages, GST-correct pricing engine, Razorpay UPI and Pine Labs card-terminal integrations, WhatsApp receipts with a retry worker, idempotent webhooks, Sentry). 18 merged pull requests upstream to hflow, Orbit and RAGFlow, with 13 more open across Keploy (Go), LlamaIndex, google-cloud-python, Hoppscotch, Chatwoot, Documenso, Omnivore, Onyx and Unstructured.
- **Software Development Engineer, myAIcademy** (Feb 2026 - Jun 2026, Hybrid, Dubai, UAE). Owned a Flutter and web AI-learning platform end to end, from Go backend services through release: 10,000+ students onboarded and 50,000+ learning sessions. Go services on Google Cloud Run and Cloud Functions with Firestore behind an OpenAPI-first REST API (70+ endpoints generated with oapi-codegen) and Dockerised Python content services. Course automation pipeline shipping persona-targeted courses within a 72-hour SLA of a new AI tool launch. Customer.io outreach system that lifted user retention by 8%.
- **AI Engineer, Peach** (May 2025 - Jan 2026, Delhi). Led AI backend and agent orchestration for a learning platform, processing 15,000+ submissions in production; automated grading that scored 5,000+ worksheets at 92% rubric accuracy; image and video analysis pipelines adopted by 20+ NGO partners; live agentic workflows with multi-turn context management that cut manual intervention per session by 60%.
- **GenAI Engineer, HYRGPT** (May 2024 - May 2025, Remote). Production voice AI assistant handling real-time Hinglish conversations at 1.5-second end-to-end latency for 500 daily active users; RAG pipeline that cut LLM inference cost by 60%; resume retrieval and ranking with vector embeddings and metadata filtering; speech-to-text and summarization with speaker diarization that cut transcript turnaround by 70%.
- **AI Research Intern, Sultan Qaboos University** (Jun 2024 - Aug 2024, Muscat, Oman). Career recommendation system combining psychometric signals, structured user data and LLM reasoning, evaluated across cultural contexts with multimodal inputs.
- **Research Intern, CSIR-IHBT** (May 2024 - Jun 2024, Palampur, India). React clinical analytics dashboard for Alzheimer's screening experiments; improved lab website page-load performance by 60%.

## Selected work

### fya, open-source security scanner  [Featured]
Dynamic application security scanner published to PyPI with 58 checks mapped to OWASP Top 10, OWASP MASVS and CWE, scanning running servers, Android APKs and source directories from one command. 800+ downloads, 42 GitHub stars. Orchestrates Nuclei, Nikto, sqlmap, nmap and testssl; emits SARIF, HTML and JSON. Live: https://fya.ayamk.in. Code: https://github.com/ayam04/fya

### oorik ERP  [Featured]
Multi-tenant SaaS ERP for Indian SMBs, built from an empty repo to production. Hono, PostgreSQL, Drizzle, row-level tenant isolation, Better Auth, Razorpay billing. Live: https://erp.oorik.in

### tech-doc-ocr
Document delta and grounded chat over engineering drawing revisions: native PDF, scanned PDF (OCR) and DXF behind one adapter interface, confidence-scored delta, redline overlay, cited answers. 0.91 precision at 0.97 recall on production P&IDs, 100% grounded answers over the labelled question set. Code: https://github.com/ayam04/tech-doc-ocr

### Deal Dossier Generator
Drop a company domain and get a meeting-ready dossier, streamed from Gemini with Google Search grounding. Live: https://dossier.ayamk.in. Code: https://github.com/ayam04/dossier

### LeetLingo, AI Interview Prep
AI interview-prep platform with personalized lessons, speech recognition and progress tracking. Live: https://leetlingo.site/

### AI Voice Screening Agent
Voice agent that screens candidates over the phone (Plivo, Deepgram, MongoDB), run in production at HyrGPT. Code: https://github.com/ayam04/ai-call

### Meeting Note-Taker AI
Transcribes, summarizes and extracts action items using speech-to-text and LLM pipelines. Code: https://github.com/ayam04/meeting-note-taker

### Multi-Agent RAG Customer Support
MongoDB, FAISS and OpenAI to retrieve and generate grounded responses across multiple data sources. Code: https://github.com/ayam04/multi-rag-customer-support

### Indian Accent Matcher
Scores similarity between Indian-accent voice samples using audio embeddings and vector search. Code: https://github.com/ayam04/audio-accent-vector-match

### PDF Vector Search
Semantic search over PDFs backed by a MongoDB vector index. Code: https://github.com/ayam04/mongoDB-pdf-vector-search
